name: Floor Descent
description: The stack of floors and the seed that makes them reproducible. Each descent increments depth and derives the floor's seed from the run seed plus depth — never a fresh random roll, because a floor that changes when you revisit it breaks both speedruns and save audits. The generator lineage matters here: the consuming app's dd-dungeon-generator.ts family already proves this contract in TypeScript outside this repository, and this descriptor is the library-native contract those generators would adapt to, not a port of them. This component owns depth, seeds, and the transition between floors. It owns nothing about room contents — world.room_template stamps the rooms, and whatever lives in them arrives via world.mob_patrol or combat.boss_encounter_script.

inputs.name: runSeed
inputs.description: The seed the whole run derives from. Required because a descent with no seed is a different dungeon every load, which is a roguelike decision, not a default.

inputs.name: maxDepth
inputs.description: Floors before the bottom, where the boss or the win condition lives. A depth budget is a session-length budget.

inputs.name: floorSizeByDepth
inputs.description: Room counts and dimensions as a function of depth, as data. Early floors small for pace, deep floors large for stakes.

inputs.name: allowAscent
inputs.description: Whether stairs go back up. Ascent enables retreat-and-return runs; disabling it makes every descent a point of no return.

outputs.name: currentDepth
outputs.description: How far down the party currently is.

outputs.name: currentFloorSeed
outputs.description: The derived seed of the active floor, exposed for regen and debugging.
